new_claims.statement: For an invertible indefinite physical pair B with kappa=sigma_min(B), its translated quadratic output has density p(t)<=4 kappa^(-1/2)|t-t0|^(-1/2) a.e.; obtained by optimizing the completed pair-log envelope pointwise.
If the pair Schur remainder has a disjoint physical cross block M with Z=e3(M^T M)>0, then ||p_Q||inf<83.480 kappa^(-1/2) Z^(-1/12).

For K={i,j}, D=|det A[K,K]|, kappa=sigma_min(A[K,K]), and global disjoint anchored five-volume Omega_K, if A[K,K] is invertible indefinite and Omega_K>0 then ||p_Q||inf<118.059 kappa^(-1/2)D^(1/6)Omega_K^(-1/12).

exact_identity: For disjoint residual cuts I,J, W_K(I,J)=sum det A[K union U,K union V]^2=D^2 e3(S[I,J]^T S[I,J]), where S is the pair Schur complement.
